newsitem.title: FINLAND: UPM declines comment on Intl Paper assets.
newsitem.headline: UPM declines comment on Intl Paper assets.

text.p: Finnish forest industry group UPM-Kymmene on Monday declined to comment on whether it was planning to buy assets from U.S. forestry group International Paper.
"We do not comment on matters like this," UPM-Kymmene spokesman Jari Lemetyinen told Reuters. "If we had made such a decision we would have announced it."

International Paper said earlier in July it would sell $1 billion worth of assets over the next year, including its imaging and multi-wall kraft, or strong brown paper, packaging businesses and 175,000 acres of timberland.
Equities analysts have said UPM-Kymmene could be embarking on an acquisition trail after selling a large chunk of its shares in telecomes froup Nokia for a 1.5 billion markka gain.
UPM had made clear it was seeking an acquisition in North America, analysts said.
